column2: [intro]
In my neon outfit, I’m ready to give it all,
I bounce like a kangaroo, ready to smash it all,
I do pirouettes, acrobatic jumps,
In squash, I’m the king, it’s my magical groove.
When I grab my racket, it sparks,
Squash is my passion, it’s the good life, it’s the sky.
I slide on the court, hitting the ball mid-flight,
Squash rocks, it’s my favorite sport, it’s my light.
With my powerful shots, I defy the laws of gravity,
I turn heads, I have style with elegance,
I’m the squash stuntman, the virtuoso, the showman,
On the court, it’s my show, my performance, my story.
When I hit the ball, I’m invincible,
I overcome all obstacles, I’m irresistible.
Squash is my drug, my adrenaline, my madness,
I’m the star of the court, everyone’s applauding.
[ solo ]
When I leave the court, I’m exhausted but satisfied,
Squash is my dose of happiness, my dose of joy.
I’m a champion at heart, I’m made for this,
Squash rocks, there’s nothing better, that’s how it is!
[outro]
